name: walk_line_all_octants

description: Clips a vertical run against a limit of 198 and, when any of it is visible, calls a routine from a fixed table slot once per row. When the low four bits of the first argument are zero it first calls a helper with a masked value.

name: scale_pair_by_lookup_table
description: Shifts three fixed-point inputs right until the bound fits its range, then scales the first two by a lookup-table value chosen by the bound's magnitude. Larger bounds use a coarser table index, and small bounds halve the products until they fit within plus or minus 7935. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B4DE
name: scale_pair_one_sided_lookup
description: Shifts the pair right while the first value is below -32768, then scales both values by a lookup-table entry chosen by the bound's magnitude. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B4F6
name: normalize_pair_with_lookup
description: Shifts the first two inputs against the third until the bound is within range, then scales them by a lookup-table value chosen by magnitude. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B51E
name: normalize_then_scale_pair
description: Shifts the second input and bound right while the first input is below -32768, then scales the pair by a lookup-table entry chosen by magnitude. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B536
name: normalize_pair_by_magnitude
description: Compares the first and third inputs in magnitude, shifts the values until the bound fits, then scales them by a lookup-table value or halves the products until they fit within plus or minus 7935. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B56C
name: scale_pair_by_indexed_table
description: Multiplies the first and second inputs by a lookup-table value selected by the third input, shifts the products, and halves them until both fit within plus or minus 7935. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B578
name: scale_pair_by_table_slot
description: Multiplies the first and second inputs by a lookup-table value indexed by the third input shifted right four bits, then shifts the products and returns them as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1B58E
name: scale_pair_after_halving
description: Halves the first and second inputs together with the third until the third is at most 32767, then multiplies the first two by a lookup-table value indexed by the reduced third input. It returns the two results as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BDB2
name: offset_recursive_result_or_floor
description: Calls a routine and adds 160 to its result when the input is greater than 63. Otherwise it returns -32768.

name: return_constant_32768

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BDD6

description: Takes the magnitudes of three signed inputs, forms the sum of their squares, and divides each input by the resulting length using bit-by-bit loops. It multiplies a final quotient by the fourth input and returns the product as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BE26
name: sqrt_divide_and_scale
description: Computes a bit-by-bit square root of the first input, uses it as a divisor for the absolute values of the next inputs, and returns the scaled quotient of the last one as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BF3A
name: find_leading_bit_value
description: Calls a routine for a 16-bit value, halves it, and doubles the result until its top bit is set. It returns the last value before that point, masked to 15 bits, or zero when the halved value is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BF58
name: retrieve_and_halve_value
description: Calls another routine to obtain a 16-bit value and returns that value shifted right by one bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BF6A
name: lookup_inverse_vector_length
description: Sums the squares of three 16-bit inputs and maps the sum to a table entry, using a different shift for each magnitude band. It returns the scaled table value as a longword.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BF74
name: lookup_scaled_longword_value
description: Maps a 32-bit input to a 16-bit table entry by shifting it into the table's range with a shift that depends on its magnitude band. It returns the table value as a longword.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BF96
name: lookup_halved_table_entry
description: Indexes a 16-bit lookup table with the input shifted right two bits and returns that entry halved.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BFA4
name: lookup_table_entry_direct
description: Indexes a 16-bit lookup table with the input shifted right four bits and returns the entry as a 16-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BFB0
name: lookup_banded_longword_value
description: Maps a 32-bit input to a table entry using a shift chosen from three magnitude bands. It returns the entry as a longword.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BFCE
name: lookup_entry_shift_three
description: Builds a table index from the upper and lower halves of a 32-bit input and returns the 16-bit table entry shifted right three bits as a longword.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1BFDE
name: lookup_entry_shift_five
description: Builds a table index from the halves of a 32-bit input using a six-bit shift and returns the table entry shifted right five bits as a longword.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1CFEE
name: compute_dot_product_columns
description: Forms two dot products between the three register inputs and two three-element vectors read from memory at interleaved offsets. Each sum is doubled, and both are returned as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1D032
name: compute_dot_product_rows
description: Forms two dot products between the three register inputs and two contiguous three-element rows read from memory. Each sum is doubled, and both are returned as a longword pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1FD30
name: project_and_emit_clipped_points

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1FD4C

name: emit_record_stack_coords_wide

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:1FE34

name: emit_indexed_pairs_counted
description: Writes a byte index and a 32-bit record into a buffer and increments the record count in the buffer header. It then writes scaled coordinate pairs from stack arguments at fixed offsets.

name: emit_point_record_fixed

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a3]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a3].adf:Frontier:5:20078
name: emit_index_record_with_count
